original_value: To provide high-precision positioning for Internet of Things (IoT) scenarios, we optimize the indoor positioning technique based on Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) equipment. This paper analyzes sources of positioning error and improves the time synchronization algorithm based on the synchronization packet. Then we use the labels of the known position to further optimize the time synchronization performance, and hence improve TDOA measurements. After time synchronization optimization, a Weighted Least Square (WLS) and Taylor coordination algorithm is derived. Experiments show that our optimization reduces the average positioning error from 54.8 cm to 12.6 cm.

result.paraphrase: To enable high-precision positioning in Internet of Things (IoT) scenarios, we refine an indoor positioning method using Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) equipment. The paper examines the causes of positioning error and enhances the time synchronization algorithm based on synchronization packets. It then uses known-position labels to further improve synchronization performance, thereby improving TDOA measurements. After synchronization optimization, a Weighted Least Square (WLS) and Taylor coordinate algorithm is derived. Experiments indicate that the optimization lowers the average positioning error from 54.8 cm to 12.6 cm.
